title: True Romance
tagline: Kung fu triple feature. Pie after.
about: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.
cue: Serve the pie when Clarence and Alabama head to the diner after the kung fu triple feature.
faces: Birthday night, kung fu triple feature and a slice of pie after. That's how I met her, and I'm not letting go.
